parole.significato: Swati, a Bantu language of the Nguni group, spoken chiefly in Eswatini and South Africa
parole.testo: Borrowed from English Swati (“the Swati language”), with English ⟨w⟩ adapted as Norwegian ⟨v⟩. The English name is ultimately from either Swazi siSwati (“the Swati language”) or emaSwati (“the Swati people”), the singular of the latter being liSwati (“a Swati person”). These forms contain the noun-c
